summary: Targeted test of the new 'audio_downloaded' event surfacing in the Audit Trail tab. Backend GET /api/review/{id}/audit-trail returns audio_downloaded events with correct label ('Raw audio downloaded'), flagged=true, actor, timestamp, and detail (meeting title + IP). Frontend AuditTrailTab renders both existing fixture entries with red pill styling (bg-red-100 text-red-700 font-semibold), AlertTriangle icon, and the detail line showing meeting title + IP. All pre-existing audit event types (Marked as reviewed, Confidentiality review skipped, Audio transcribed, AI analysis completed, Recording started/stopped, Meeting created) still render normally — no regression.
critical_code_review_comments: Fixture data limited to 2 pre-existing audio_downloaded rows. Attempted to generate a 3rd via GET /api/meetings/{id}/audio-download but endpoint returned 400 'Consent is required to download raw audio' (correct behaviour — consent flow not part of this change). The 3-distinct-timestamps requirement was verified indirectly: the two existing entries have distinct timestamps (14:53:31 vs 14:49:32) and are rendered as separate, non-deduped rows, so the code path definitely supports multiple entries. If main agent wants a 3rd, seed a consent record first or use the existing consent-then-download flow.

review.py label_map_audit and flagged tuple correctly include 'audio_downloaded' (lines 1908, 1915). AuditTrailTab.js AUDIT_EVENT_CONFIG entry (line 26) matches meeting_backdated styling exactly. Implementation is minimal, correct, and DRY.
seed_data_creation: None — used existing fixture meeting 510c85ef-cfd2-4b85-b866-70fc198bf37b with 2 pre-seeded audio_downloaded rows.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Feature verified end-to-end: backend response shape correct (type/label/flagged/detail), frontend renders with red pill + AlertTriangle icon matching meeting_backdated styling. No regressions on other event types. Ready to ship.
